en.title: Handel–Halvorsen: Passacaglia for Violin and Viola – Listening Guide
en.overview: This piece opens with a four-measure theme. It is followed by 24 variations, each about four measures long. A variation is a new version of the same material. The home key is G minor. Keys and chords here are estimated by computer, and the score reading may be imprecise in small details. So the guide follows the big picture: who leads, loud and soft, and changes of key. Listen for the long stretch of quiet playing in the middle and the loud peak around measure 71. Listen also for the loud ending.

listening_points.headline: The theme, loud and bold in the violin
listening_points.text: The violin plays the opening theme at full strength [m. 1-4]. The viola accompanies. The key is G minor. Remember this tune. Later versions only hint at it.

listening_points.headline: Variation 1: the viola takes over
listening_points.text: The volume stays very loud [m. 5-8]. The analysis says the viola probably leads. The tune is shared between both instruments. A softening marking appears at [m. 8].

listening_points.headline: Variation 2: a hush, then a brighter key
listening_points.text: The music drops to very soft [m. 9-12]. The violin probably leads. Near the end, the key estimate moves to F major [m. 12]. F major usually sounds a little brighter than G minor.

listening_points.headline: Variation 3: quiet, in F major, shared lead
listening_points.text: The key stays F major [m. 13-16]. The playing stays very soft. Both players share the lead in much of it. Listen to the two lines weaving together.

listening_points.headline: Variation 4: back to G minor
listening_points.text: The key returns to G minor [m. 17]. The music is soft, but a little louder than before. The lead passes from violin to viola around [m. 19].

listening_points.headline: Variation 5: a louder burst, then a drop
listening_points.text: This variation starts loud [m. 21]. At the end the volume falls to very soft [m. 24]. Listen for that sudden change of volume.

listening_points.headline: Variations 6 and 7: softer and busier
listening_points.text: The music stays soft [m. 25-32]. The analysis finds more notes than in the theme. The violin probably leads, so the writing sounds more flowing.

listening_points.headline: Variations 8 to 10: chords move together
listening_points.text: The variations stay soft [m. 34-44]. In several measures the two instruments move together in block-like chords [m. 37-38] and [m. 40-42]. The notes here are much busier than in the theme. Who leads is unclear at the start, so the lead is probably shared.

listening_points.headline: Variations 11 and 12: the tune is clearer in violin
listening_points.text: The viola leads for a moment at [m. 46]. In Variation 12 the violin carries more of the theme's notes [m. 49-52]. The level falls to very soft at [m. 50].

listening_points.headline: Variations 13 to 16: a long, quiet stretch
listening_points.text: This is a long, very soft passage [m. 53-66]. The lead probably moves to the viola around [m. 58-62]. The analysis is unsure there, so the lead may be shared. Listen to the delicate give and take.

listening_points.headline: A single violin line, then a new key
listening_points.text: The texture is marked as solo [m. 67-70]. The violin leads, and the volume stays very soft. At [m. 68] the key estimate moves to E-flat major. That gives a new colour.

listening_points.headline: The peak: very loud chords
listening_points.text: The two instruments play together in very loud chords [m. 71-72]. The analysis marks measure 71 as the loudest and busiest point. It follows very soft playing, so it stands out.

listening_points.headline: Variation 18: the softest music, in C minor
listening_points.text: After the peak the music falls to the softest marking in the piece [m. 73]. The key estimate returns to G minor and then moves to C minor [m. 74]. The texture is mostly block-like chords.

listening_points.headline: Variations 19 and 20: F major, then home
listening_points.text: The key estimate moves to F major [m. 78]. It settles back to G minor at [m. 83]. Variation 20 is soft, and the viola has most of the theme's notes there [m. 81-84].

listening_points.headline: Variations 21 and 22: the violin has the tune
listening_points.text: The viola leads at the start of Variation 21 [m. 85-86]. The violin takes over at [m. 87]. In Variation 22 the violin carries most of the theme's notes [m. 89-92]. The playing is soft but very busy, in chords with the viola.

listening_points.headline: Variations 23 and 24: a loud finish
listening_points.text: The music turns very loud at [m. 93]. It drops to very soft for one measure [m. 95]. It then returns to very loud [m. 96-97] and ends on a loud final measure [m. 98], still in G minor.

glossary.explanation: A new version of the opening four-measure idea. Each one changes the tune, the busyness or the mood.
The home note and mood of the music. Minor keys often sound darker. Major keys often sound brighter.
A move from one key to another.
Both instruments move together in chords, rather than each having its own line.
Both instruments play interesting lines, sharing the music.
One instrument plays by itself in the analysis.
Loudness marks: very loud, loud, soft, very soft, and softest of all.
The keys and chords are guessed by a computer program. They may contain errors.

zh.title: 亨德尔–哈尔沃森:《帕萨卡利亚》(小提琴与中提琴)听赏指南
zh.overview: 这是一首由一段4小节的短乐段不断变奏而成的乐曲,共有24次变奏。请留意谁领奏、力度忽强忽弱,以及调性的几次转换。和声与调性由电脑自动估计,可能有误。乐谱来自光学识别,节奏细节可能不准,所以本指南侧重大轮廓:段落、调性、领奏、强弱。

listening_points.headline: 小提琴领奏,以很强的力度开场
listening_points.text: 乐曲以很强(ff)开始,调性是G小调。小提琴领奏,中提琴在一旁伴奏 [m. 1-4]。请记住这段开头的旋律,它是本乐章的出发点。

listening_points.headline: 第一变奏:中提琴接过领奏
listening_points.text: 第一变奏仍然很强。这次大概由中提琴领奏,两件乐器更像二重奏 [m. 5-8]。

listening_points.headline: 突然变得很弱,并转到F大调
listening_points.text: 第二变奏的力度突然降到很弱(pp)[m. 9-12]。大约从 [m. 12] 起,调性估计转为F大调,色彩更明亮。第三变奏继续保持很弱 [m. 13-16]。

listening_points.headline: 回到G小调,力度起伏
listening_points.text: 第四变奏回到G小调,力度为弱(p)[m. 17-20]。第五变奏突然变强(f)[m. 21-23]。到 [m. 24] 又突然变回很弱。

listening_points.headline: 保持轻柔的弱奏
listening_points.text: 第六、七变奏保持弱奏 [m. 25-32]。小提琴大概多半领奏。第八变奏仍然很轻,并带有渐强的标记 [m. 34-37]。

listening_points.headline: 两条声部同步前进
listening_points.text: 第九、十变奏里,两件乐器有时一起走相同的节奏,这叫主调织体,听起来像和弦的行进 [m. 37-38]、[m. 40-42]。力度仍是弱。

listening_points.headline: 渐渐安静,力度越来越弱
listening_points.text: 第十一变奏中,中提琴在 [m. 46] 大概短暂领奏。第十二变奏进入很弱的力度 [m. 50]。第十三变奏继续很弱 [m. 53-56]。

listening_points.headline: 领奏不定,声音很轻
listening_points.text: 第十四、十五变奏中,中提琴可能更多地领奏,但领奏并不明确,请当作两者分享 [m. 58-62]。力度保持在弱到很弱之间。

listening_points.headline: 小提琴独奏,转入降E大调
listening_points.text: 在 [m. 67-70],只有小提琴在奏。从 [m. 68] 起,调性估计转为降E大调,色彩变得开阔。声音仍然很弱。

listening_points.headline: 分析估计的高点:突然很强
listening_points.text: 第十七变奏中,力度从很弱突然跳到很强(ff)[m. 71-72]。分析(电脑估计)把本乐章最响最忙的地方标在 [m. 71]。两件乐器同步,像一组组和弦。

listening_points.headline: 极弱的一段,转向C小调与F大调
listening_points.text: 高点之后,声音突然降到极弱(ppp)[m. 73-76]。调性先回G小调,随后转为C小调 [m. 74],更暗。到 [m. 78] 又转为F大调。

listening_points.headline: 回到G小调,力度转弱
listening_points.text: 第二十变奏以突然的很强音开始,随即转为弱 [m. 81]。到 [m. 83] 调性回到G小调,并保持到结尾。第二十一变奏里,中提琴在 [m. 85-86] 大概领奏。

listening_points.headline: 小提琴领奏,和弦式前进
listening_points.text: 第二十二变奏中,小提琴清楚地领奏 [m. 89-92]。两件乐器同步,织体是主调式,力度为弱。

listening_points.headline: 强弱对比后,以强奏收束
listening_points.text: 第二十三变奏以很强开始 [m. 93],在 [m. 95] 突然很弱,[m. 96] 又很强。最后一次变奏在很强中开始,以强结束 [m. 97-98]。

glossary.explanation: 一种反复变奏的乐曲。短短的乐段不断重复,每次都换一种写法。
把同一段乐句换个样子再奏一遍,比如更快、更轻或换声部。
两个声部节奏大致相同,一起前进,听起来像和弦。
音乐的中心音换了,听感随之变亮或变暗。
此处指带着最突出旋律的声部。这是电脑估计,不一定准确。
